quarterly_data.quarter: Shijia Photons results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Ge Haiquan and CFO Zhao Yantao (2025 annual and Q1 2026 results briefing): in Q1 2026, driven by AI, the datacom market grew fast and orders for the company's main products such as optical chips and devices rose year on year to varying degrees, with customer recognition up markedly and profitability significantly improved through cost reduction and higher yields. Ge said its optical chips span passive and active platforms on a full IDM flow from chip design and wafer fabrication to packaging and test; with 800G/1.6T high-speed products ramping fast and silicon photonics widely adopted, its datacom products are expected to keep benefiting. He said the rise in the top-five customers' share reflects the high concentration of downstream optical-communication customers, and the company is deepening strategic cooperation with mainstream optical-module makers (not named). He also said the planned purchase of control of Dongguan Fukexima Communication Technology was still in due diligence, audit and valuation.
